meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 按 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式在 NanoClaw 群组维护常驻知识库:建 wiki/ 与 sources/ 及索引日志,改群组说明让它逐份处理资料并写页面;遇网址下载全文而非摘要。
howto.when: 当你说“add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base”等关键词,或要求给群组建立 wiki 知识库时触发。

say.text: 给这个群加上 wiki,主题是项目管理。
say.note: Claude 会先说明模式,再问放到哪个群。

say.text: 把我的 PDF 资料逐份加进 wiki,每份先讨论再建页面。
say.note: 它会一次只处理一个文件,不批量读。

say.text: 每周安排一次 wiki 健康检查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude maintains a persistent wiki knowledge base: creates wiki/ and sources/ plus index/log, edits CLAUDE.md to enforce one-at-a-time ingestion, and downloads full URL content via command line instead of summaries.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say “add wiki”, “wiki”, “knowledge base”, etc., or ask to set up a wiki knowledge base for the group.

say_en.text: Add a wiki to this group on project management.
say_en.note: Claude explains the pattern and asks which group to use.

say_en.text: Add my PDFs to the wiki one file at a time, discuss each before writing pages.
say_en.note: It processes one file at a time instead of batching.

say_en.text: Schedule a weekly wiki health check.
say_en.note: Claude schedules the lint task via schedule_task.
